phase3_findings.description: Stale coupled comment: the pretooluse_guard_fired output block still says "Same `|| 'unavailable'` ... as permission_denials_count above", but this diff rewrote permission_denials_count to the string-equality form, so the cross-reference is now false.

The rewritten workflow comment misdiagnoses the old `|| 'unavailable'` form as risking "swallowing a measured 0" with "undocumented" `"0"` coercion; in GitHub Actions any non-empty string (incl. "0") is documented-truthy, so the old form would NOT have swallowed a measured 0 — the real bug was upstream in the jq extractor. Comment rationale is factually wrong (behavior-inert).

`_result_present` comment claims `### Run summary` renders "iff a result event was found"; the jq else-branch actually renders it when `$r != null` OR gathered denials > 0. The gate is behaviorally SAFE (the drift warning can only fire when count==unavailable, which requires denials==0, forcing $r!=null), only the "iff" wording overstates the invariant.

The new three-denial-array fixture asserts the rendered block and step output but not that the operator-facing `::warning::DevFlow: this run recorded 3 permission denial(s)` fires off the new array-derived count path — the old shape has this assertion, the new shape (the point of the issue) does not.

build-denial-record.sh:109 comment says the array-presence signal is "read BEFORE the object filter above" — positionally it is bound after $denials_all via its own independent descent; the sibling surface-diagnostics comment ("before the object-type filter drops entries") is the accurate phrasing.
BDR side asserts drift-warning presence but not single-emit idempotency (grep -c == 1); the diagnostics side pins it. A duplicate-emit regression in build-denial-record.sh would pass.

report: APPROVE WITH ADVISORY NOTES. The core fix is correct on every risk axis: both extractors add a $has_pd_array presence signal computed before the object-type filter so an empty/all-non-object permission_denials array is a measured 0; the unavailable sentinel is preserved for the neither-carrier case (verified by fixtures); the shape-drift warning uses a prefix distinct from the greped `this run recorded` prefix; `_publish_denials` read-back stays bash-builtin-only; old-shape count-field behavior is unchanged; the devflow-runner.yml string-equality output mapping correctly passes a measured 0 through (GHA step outputs are strings and "0" is documented-truthy) and resolves unavailable only on empty publish, with the coupled run.sh pin updated in the same change; changeset (bump: patch) and coverage-map ratchet present. All seven acceptance criteria have corresponding assertions. The all-non-object-array-as-measured-0 behavior silent-failure-hunter flagged is explicitly specified by the issue's implementation notes and asserted by a fixture, so it is intended design, not a defect. No correctness blocker. Advisory findings: a stale coupled comment and a factually-wrong rationale comment in devflow-runner.yml, one imprecise (but behaviorally-safe) comment in surface-execution-diagnostics.sh, and a test-coverage gap (the new three-denial array shape does not assert the operator denial warning fires). These are behavior-inert and cap at advisory/suggestion under Phase 4.1.5.
